text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In case reports, events reported after intake of RUZURGI at doses of 300 mg per day or greater (more than three times the maximum recommended daily dosage) include vomiting, nystagmus, seizures and status epilepticus, rhabdomyolysis, chest pain, diaphoresis, palpitations, paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, transient QTc prolongation, aspiration with acute respiratory failure, and cardiac arrest. Patients with suspected overdose with RUZURGI should be monitored for signs or symptoms of exaggerated RUZURGI adverse reactions or effects, and appropriate symptomatic treatment instituted immediately.
